WITH vote_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_country,
    pav.points_won / pav.points_max AS share
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE pav.points_max > 0 
    AND pav.points_won IS NOT NULL 
    AND pav.points_max IS NOT NULL
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(death_country, '') AS country,
    AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM vote_shares
  GROUP BY COALESCE(death_country, '')
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_share) AS mean_avg_share
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.country,
  ca.avg_share,
  ca.avg_share / om.mean_avg_share AS relative_ratio
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY ca.country;

assumptions.assumption: Rows where points_max is NULL, zero, or points_won is NULL are skipped; all remaining valid shares are averaged per country regardless of vote count
